guidebook.intro: Fumba emmere era ogobererere ebiragiro by’okufumba mu Lungereza.

tips.title: Ebiragiro by’omu ffumbiro
body: Ebiragiro bitandika n’ekikolwa: **Put the pot on the fire. Add oil. Cut the onions.** Okwongera obuntu: **Please**, **a little**: **Add a little salt, please.**

tips.title: First, then …
body: Okulaga omutendera: **First** (sooka), **then** (oluvannyuma), **after that**, **finally**: **First cut the onions. Then add the tomatoes.**

culture.title: “Webale okufumba”
body: Mu Lungereza osobola okugamba **Thanks for cooking!**, naye abantu batera okutendereza emmere: **The food is delicious!** **Thank you for the meal.**
